population: Use the entire registered cross-window long-prefix panel: 99 chronological endpoints/185 distinct earlier-to-later evidence questions in the six training histories, disjoint from all 466 local randomized questions. No independent validation or test cases.
policy: Carry the already fixed passage/evidence actor, all controls and unchanged held-history donor/calibration rules to the last decision of each real prefix. Only the visible final session supplies target turns; the raw anchor uses the actual reached controller state. Extend the original 128-session vectors only for missing target sessions with the same anonymized Qwen encoder on one guarded GPU at batch 2, <=0.30 duty and >=2GiB headroom. Re-encode one original session and verify parity. Freeze every endpoint offset before scoring. Record exposed branches, including partially completed endpoints, at this distinct numeric freeze. Reproduce the local predictions for overlapping sessions.
measurement: Verify both full trajectories, every scored question, the common earlier ordered actions and the physical final predecision state. Report measured final-span E[F1], matched rate, stage direction alignment, source evidence gaps, actual costs and whole-history intervals. Compare raw/native/terminal, rotated labels, placebo source, evidence-only, eligible-passage-only and parent. The earlier decisions are fixed; this is the causal effect of the last probability change on cross-session questions, not an on-policy full-history rollout.
